response.sql:
WITH constructor_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.constructorId,
    c.nationality,
    COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS record_count
  FROM constructors c
  LEFT JOIN constructorStandings cs ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality
),
average_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM constructor_counts
)
SELECT 
  cc.constructorId,
  cc.nationality,
  cc.record_count,
  cc.record_count - ac.avg_count AS difference_from_average
FROM constructor_counts cc
CROSS JOIN average_calc ac
WHERE cc.record_count > ac.avg_count
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: "Standings records" refers to rows in the constructorStandings table (one row per constructor per race in the season standings).
